incompleteCases.question: 有商品点击的搜索记录中，哪些关键词最常点到哪个英文类目的商品？取前 20。
品牌销售额排名前 10 是哪些？销售额按商品金额统计。
物流轨迹事件类型按客户所在州分布，列出前 20 组（按发货单去重）。
各工单类目、优先级的工单数和消息条数分别是多少？
按宏观区域和出入库类型统计库存变动笔数与数量合计。

itemEvidence.finalSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE price > 1000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_city) FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_status) FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, price
FROM order_items ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items ORDER BY freight_value DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card';

SELECT order_id, payment_installments
FROM order_payments ORDER BY payment_installments DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_weight_g > 5000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE freight_value > 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE price < 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE level_id = 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE status = 2;
SELECT member_id, points FROM members ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses;

SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, capacity
FROM warehouses ORDER BY capacity DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE status = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE reason_code = 'QUAL';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupons;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupons WHERE discount_type = 'fixed';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_categories;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity < safety_stock;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_movements WHERE movement_type = 2;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT keyword) FROM search_logs;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE macro_region = 'Sudeste';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns WHERE status = 3;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_price_history;
SELECT SUM(price) FROM order_items;
SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM order_items;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM order_items LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t LIMIT 201
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score LIMIT 201

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total
FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS total
FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'canceled') AS canceled FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card') AS credit_card, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'boleto') AS boleto FROM order_payments LIMIT 201
SELECT level_id, ROUND(AVG(points), 2) AS avg_points FROM members GROUP BY level_id ORDER BY level_id LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT macro_region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM regions GROUP BY macro_region ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campaigns GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_id, budget FROM campaigns ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT discount_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM coupons GROUP BY discount_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM refunds LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 LIMIT 201
SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM inventory;
SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_movements GROUP BY movement_type ORDER BY movement_type LIMIT 201
SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY category_id LIMIT 201
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority LIMIT 201
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM settlements GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) FROM settlements LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) FROM settlements LIMIT 201

SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM search_logs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM order_items;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score >= 4)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*), 4) AS good_rate FROM order_reviews LIMIT 201
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1) SELECT m AS month, cnt, cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m) AS mom_change FROM monthly ORDER BY m LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1) SELECT m AS month, cnt, ROUND((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m))::NUMERIC / NULLIF(LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m), 0), 4) AS mom_rate FROM monthly ORDER BY m LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT cur.mo AS month, cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change FROM monthly cur JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017 WHERE cur.yr = 2018 ORDER BY cur.mo LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp > (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders) - INTERVAL '90 days';

WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS mx FROM orders) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS week_start, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp > a.mx - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= a.mx GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS dow, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 4) AS late_rate FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600), 2) FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', register_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members WHERE register_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members
WHERE last_login_date > (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - 30;
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start) AS month, ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS total FROM settlements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM order_items oi GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_price_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE h.product_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM members m
LEFT JOIN user_tag_map t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE t.member_id IS NULL;
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_value FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.review_score <= 2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_payments p JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS cnt FROM user_tag_map m JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = m.tag_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM user_tag_map tm
JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = tm.tag_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = tm.member_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE t.tag_code = 'HIGH_VALUE';
SELECT c.campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) FROM coupon_usages LIMIT 201
SELECT c.discount_type, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS total FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT w.warehouse_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity FROM warehouses w JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_capacity DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT carrier, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days LIMIT 201

SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_qty, ROUND(AVG(i.quantity), 2) AS avg_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT tc.category_name, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600), 2) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets st JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets st JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total
FROM settlements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(st.net_amount), 2) AS total FROM settlements st JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = st.seller_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rf.refund_id) AS cnt FROM refunds rf JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = rf.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM refunds)::NUMERIC / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 4) AS refund_rate LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS avg_per_customer FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_per_customer DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS cnt FROM members m JOIN user_tag_map tm ON tm.member_id = m.member_id JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = tm.tag_id WHERE t.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*), 4) AS ctr FROM search_logs LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IS NULL;

SELECT b.brand_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN product_brand_map bm ON bm.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = bm.brand_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_price_history WHERE new_price > old_price;

SELECT s.status, ROUND(AVG(t.cnt), 2) AS avg_events FROM shipments s JOIN (SELECT shipment_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipment_tracking GROUP BY 1) t ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers, ROUND(COUNT(o.order_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS orders_per_customer FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS product_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight
FROM products p
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY product_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english, ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amt
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY refund_amt DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) AS shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM shipments s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.order_id) AS used_orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = cu.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_state, ml.level_name, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS tickets
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT sl.keyword, t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS clicks
FROM search_logs sl
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = sl.clicked_product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = sl.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE sl.clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT mlr.level_name AS referrer_level, mli.level_name AS invitee_level, COUNT(*) AS referrals, ROUND(SUM(rf.reward_amount), 2) AS reward FROM referrals rf JOIN members mr ON mr.member_id = rf.referrer_member_id JOIN member_levels mlr ON mlr.level_id = mr.level_id JOIN members mi ON mi.member_id = rf.invitee_member_id JOIN member_levels mli ON mli.level_id = mi.level_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY referrals DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_items
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY low_stock_items DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT st.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_category_name_english) AS category_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(si.commission_amount), 2) AS commission
FROM settlements st
JOIN settlement_items si ON si.settlement_id = st.settlement_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = si.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY commission DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT b.brand_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = oi.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ut.tag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM user_tag_map utm JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = utm.member_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY members DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM campaign_products cp
JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ml_cur.level_name AS current_level, ml_snap.level_name AS snapshot_level, COUNT(DISTINCT ms.member_id) AS member_cnt FROM member_snapshot ms JOIN members m ON m.member_id = ms.member_id JOIN member_levels ml_cur ON ml_cur.level_id = m.level_id JOIN member_levels ml_snap ON ml_snap.level_id = ms.level_id WHERE ms.level_id <> m.level_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY member_cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT st.event_code, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) AS shipments
FROM shipment_tracking st
JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = st.shipment_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT t.product_category_name_english, r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds, ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS amt
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT tc.category_name, st.priority, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS tickets, COUNT(tm.message_id) AS messages FROM support_tickets st JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT sa.state AS addr_state, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM shipping_addresses sa
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sa.customer_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE sa.is_default
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT p.product_category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(pph.new_price - pph.old_price), 2) AS avg_price_change,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders
FROM product_price_history pph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pph.product_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pph.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.macro_region, im.movement_type, COUNT(*) AS movements, SUM(im.quantity) AS qty FROM inventory_movements im JOIN inventory i ON i.warehouse_id = im.warehouse_id AND i.product_id = im.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = im.warehouse_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY movements DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS gmv_with_freight, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales_without_freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS buyers, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM per_user LIMIT 201

WITH first_order AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), cohort AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', first_ts)::date AS cohort_month FROM first_order WHERE first_ts >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < DATE '2017-07-01'), returner AS (SELECT DISTINCT co.customer_unique_id, co.cohort_month FROM cohort co JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01') SELECT co.cohort_month, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(re.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM cohort co LEFT JOIN returner re ON re.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH member_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), all_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * mo.n / ao.n, 2) AS penetration_pct FROM member_orders mo CROSS JOIN all_orders ao LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date) / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_time_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

WITH r AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS n FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * r.n / a.n, 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM r CROSS JOIN a LIMIT 201

WITH sold AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), allp AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * s.n / a.n, 2) AS sell_through_pct FROM sold s CROSS JOIN allp a LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_pct
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_pct DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS ctr_pct FROM search_logs LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS freight_pct FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY freight_pct DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS mau FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS discount, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cu.discount_amount) / SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS discount_pct FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = cu.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

WITH user_level AS (SELECT m.member_id, ml.level_name FROM members m JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id), user_orders AS (SELECT ul.level_name, c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM user_level ul JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = (SELECT m2.customer_unique_id FROM members m2 WHERE m2.member_id = ul.member_id) JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT level_name, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(order_cnt), 2) AS orders_per_user, ROUND(AVG(gmv), 2) AS gmv_per_user FROM user_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv_per_user DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT tc.category_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0 <= tc.sla_hours) / COUNT(*), 2) AS sla_pct FROM support_tickets st JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sla_pct LIMIT 201

WITH brand_products AS (
  SELECT b.brand_id, b.brand_name, pbm.product_id
  FROM brands b
  JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.brand_id = b.brand_id AND pbm.is_current
),
sales AS (
  SELECT bp.brand_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sold_products,
         SUM(oi.price) AS sales
  FROM brand_products bp
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = bp.product_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
total AS (
  SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS product_cnt FROM brand_products GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT bp.brand_name, t.product_cnt, COALESCE(s.sold_products, 0) AS sold_products,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.sales, 0), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(s.sold_products, 0) / t.product_cnt, 2) AS sell_through_pct
FROM brands bp
JOIN total t ON t.brand_id = bp.brand_id
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.brand_id = bp.brand_id
ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct, ROUND(SUM(reward_amount) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL), 2) AS reward_per_converted FROM referrals LIMIT 201

WITH user_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, BOOL_OR(m.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_member, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN is_member THEN 'member' ELSE 'non_member' END AS user_type, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM user_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH seller_rate AS (SELECT st.seller_id, SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(si.commission_amount) AS commission, CASE WHEN SUM(si.gross_amount) > 0 THEN SUM(si.commission_amount) / SUM(si.gross_amount) ELSE 0 END AS rate FROM settlements st JOIN settlement_items si ON si.settlement_id = st.settlement_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission) / SUM(gross), 4) AS platform_rate, ROUND(MIN(rate), 4) AS min_seller_rate, ROUND(AVG(rate), 4) AS avg_seller_rate, ROUND(MAX(rate), 4) AS max_seller_rate FROM seller_rate LIMIT 201

WITH user_gmv AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), ranked AS (SELECT gmv, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS quintile FROM user_gmv) SELECT quintile, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gmv) / (SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM user_gmv), 2) AS gmv_pct FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT m18.mo, ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017, ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018, ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / m17.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM monthly m18 JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017 WHERE m18.yr = 2018 ORDER BY m18.mo LIMIT 201

WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_ts FROM inventory_movements), outbound AS (SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS out_qty FROM inventory_movements im, anchor a WHERE im.movement_type = 2 AND im.moved_at > a.max_ts - INTERVAL '90 days' AND im.moved_at <= a.max_ts GROUP BY 1), stock AS (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS stock_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.warehouse_name, s.stock_qty, COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) AS out_qty_90d, CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(90.0 * s.stock_qty / o.out_qty, 1) END AS turnover_days FROM warehouses w JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id ORDER BY turnover_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT r.reason_code, ROUND(AVG(rev.review_score), 2) AS avg_score, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rev.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_pct FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_score_pct DESC LIMIT 201

WITH first_order AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month, c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT m.month, ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_ts)::date = m.month), 2) AS new_customer_gmv, ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_ts)::date <> m.month), 2) AS returning_gmv FROM monthly m JOIN first_order f ON f.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
